scope: Native JSON benchmark, not HTTP or overall application performance.
correctness: Untimed one-call common.dart snapshot; exact VM stdout and empty stderr in normal execution. Optional full JSON stress is supplementary; reserve lifetime stress is covered by focused runtime tests.
timing: Original common.dart only after parent grants isolated quiet window.
kernel_statistic: Each fresh process retains raw rounds; compare process median excluding first round. No pooling across modes.
process_wall_scope: Includes document generation, deterministic validation and all nine kernels; not interchangeable with per-kernel time.
provenance: Pin compiler/input/harness/artifact SHA256; identical SDK and profile flags; ARC_CHECK=1 both sides; no GC stress during timing.
limitation: JSON contains list growth amid parsing, map/string/number work; a supplemental growth-only kernel may be needed if the effect is buried. No causal speed claim without isolated results.
diagnostic_scope: DARTFORGE_ARC_CHECK=1 and DARTFORGE_EFFECTS=check are enabled. ARC synchronization audits are included; these samples are not production throughput and do not support cross-mode ARC comparisons.
